# Gravelly Sand (Poly Haven)

- Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/gravelly_sand (downloaded 2026-11-19 from dl.polyhaven.org)
- Author: Dario Barresi
- Licence: CC0 1.0 (public domain): https://polyhaven.com/license
- Real-world size of one tile: 2.48 × 2.48 m
- Files (re-encoded as JPEG to save space; content unchanged):
  - `gravelly_sand_diff_2k.jpg`: colour (sRGB), 2048², quality 80
  - `gravelly_sand_nor_gl_2k.jpg`: normal map (OpenGL convention, +Y up), 2048², quality 85
  - `gravelly_sand_arm_1k.jpg`: packed ambient occlusion (R), roughness (G), metalness (B), 1024²
- Used by `js/render/environments/ground.js` for the Outdoor range floor and stones.
